bench.corpus: tests/load/corpus.py medium — 561 records, realistic shaping-document bodies
bench.derating_assumed: a throttled Cloud Run vCPU is assumed 2-3x slower than an M4 performance core on single-threaded CPython. An assumption, the same one docs/probes/load/write-same.md states.
bench.python: CPython 3.12.13, one uvicorn worker, --auth dev, bare file:// origin, 127.0.0.1 only, ports 8900-8999
bench.room: task-000000 (tasks/task-000000--task-1.md); all fifteen sockets on it
bench.typing: 4.4 code points a second each, a pause at the end of every line staggered per person, every person at its own anchor; coeditor-14 types astral characters, combining marks, a ZWJ family and a regional-indicator pair

question: fifteen co-editors in ONE room, typing at once: what it costs, whether the room ever commits, and whether every character survives

driver.note: the harness applies every update in fifteen documents; the server applies each update once. A driver above ~1.0 core-seconds per wall second is the GIL, and every latency here would then be partly its own.
